# Public assets

Place these files here so they are served at `/assets/`:

**About section:**

- portrait.jpg – Your profile photo for the About section. If missing, a placeholder is shown.

**Project images** (used in the Projects section):

- project-1.jpg
- project-2.jpg
- project-3.jpg
- project-4.jpg
- project-5.jpg

**Resume:**

- Bruce-Pius-Resume.pdf – Your resume. The nav “Resume” link points to `/assets/Bruce-Pius-Resume.pdf`. Rename your file to match (no spaces) or update the link in `navbar.jsx`.
